{{Quote|Her actions on Geonosis, Centares, and Dagu were cited by Palpatine in a list of notable accomplishments by the Togruta Jedi Master.|[[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]], about [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]]|<ref name="RHNCE" />}}
The '''Battle of Centares''' was a conflict during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="RHNCE" /> Early during the conflict, the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Twelfth Army/Legends|Twelfth Army]] moved its forces from [[Lantillies/Legends|Lantillies]] to [[Centares/Legends|Centares]].<ref name="TEGtW" /> [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Shaak Ti/Legends|Shaak Ti]] was later commended by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] for her actions on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="RHNCE" />
